claims.quote: Schistura vinciguerrae is a nemacheilid loach from the Irrawaddy, Salween and Chindwin river basins in Myanmar and northeastern India.
Schistura vinciguerrae is a nemacheilid loach from the Irrawaddy, Salween and Chindwin river basins in Myanmar and northeastern India.

Type locality is 'Meekalam, Myanmar', corresponding to an area in current-day Tanintharyi Region, Myanmar, and this species is known from the Irrawaddy and Salween river basins in Myanmar, plus the Chindwin watershed in Myanmar and northeastern India.

Type locality is 'Meekalam, Myanmar', corresponding to an area in current-day Tanintharyi Region, Myanmar, and this species is known from the Irrawaddy and Salween river basins in Myanmar, plus the Chindwin watershed in Myanmar and northeastern India.
Unconfirmed records also exist from the Salween basin in Yunnan Province, China.
At one locality in Myanmar it was collected from fast-flowing channels with bare substrates, close to a waterfall.
